g.text: A. Whole orbits (equal scales). Focus = black dot. Points 1-3 and 6-8 are labelled in B.

svg.text: local minimum (segment joins the two points)
Numbers = rows of the table in README.
Each segment joins X₁(f₁) on orbit 1 to X₂(f₂) on orbit 2 at a critical point of d²; at a non-intersection critical point it is perpendicular to both orbits.
